title.en: Which printed window fits this check: which mortar sprayer is printed for no 380 V
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：没有 380V 时，印了哪台砂浆喷涂机

description.en: Taken from the printed row: Type 511 diesel, for the 3 m³/h mortar window. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, mixing ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 6 mm, 30 m / 15 m, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The sheet does not print engine kilowatts or horsepower. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not borrow 28/32 HP from the diesel concrete sprayer or 7.5 kW from electric Type 511.
description.zh: 511 柴油机，对应 3 m³/h 的砂浆窗口。河北品锦机械（邢台）印了柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m、外形 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm、360 kg。该页没有印发动机千瓦或马力。不要向柴油混凝土喷涂机借 28/32 HP，也不要向电动 511 借 7.5 kW。

heading.en: Example - Torque exerted by a Wrench

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Example - Torque exerted by a Wrench” from “Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: Type 511 diesel: diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, ≤ 6 mm, 30 m / 15 m, 360 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, mixing ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 6 mm, 30 m / 15 m, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric Type 511 is 7.5 kW, 260 kg and 1700 × 550 × 900 mm on 380 V. Keep this cell as published. The diesel concrete spraying machine prints 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, ≤ 6 mm and 80 m / 40 m at 480 kg. Taken from the printed row: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes, the same hose cell as electric Type 511. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Both print 360 kg. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/torque-d_991.html
body.zh: 本节保留《Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter》的标题“例子扭矩”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。目录里已经写着：511 柴油机：柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m、360 kg。该页没有印出发动机千瓦或马力。按邢台表上的原文理解：柴油混凝土喷涂机印的是 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 6 mm、80 m / 40 m、480 kg。作业对得上那一行混凝土喷涂时才用它，而不是只要无 380V 的 3 m³/h 砂浆窗口。旁边那一台不在这句话里。是，和电动 511 的软管格相同。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/torque-d_991.html

body.en: The section shape comes from “Moment Converter” in “Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Engine kW and HP are not printed on that sheet. Taken from the printed row: The sheet does not print engine kilowatts or horsepower. Read it in the Xingtai table. The diesel page keeps 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, ≤ 6 mm and 30 m / 15 m, and changes the power, the mass and the frame. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use it when the job is that concrete-sprayer row, not when you only needed the 3 m³/h mortar window without 380 V. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. The German type is 380 V, 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa and ≤ 5 mm.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter》的“弯矩”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：511 柴油机，对应 3 m³/h 的砂浆窗口。邢台河北品锦机械印了柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m、外形 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm、360 kg。该页没有印发动机千瓦或马力。不要向柴油混凝土喷涂机借 28/32 HP，也不要向电动 511 借 7.5 kW。目录里已经写着：不要索取这一页没有印出的发动机千瓦数。按邢台表上的原文理解：不能。柴油30是 15 m³/h 的混凝土管道泵。

body.en: “Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter” breaks its subject at “Law of Lever”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Type 511 diesel, for the 3 m³/h mortar window. Keep this cell as published. Do not borrow 28/32 HP from the diesel concrete sprayer or 7.5 kW from electric Type 511. Taken from the printed row: Sites that do have 380 V should use the electric page. Do not ask for an engine kilowatt figure this sheet leaves that cell blank for. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 30 is a 15 m³/h concrete pipeline pump. Taken from the printed row: The weight match is not the same machine. Headings already printed: The 5 m³/h diesel sprayer is coarser work
body.zh: 《Torque or Moment of Force - Online Converter》在“定律”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动 511 是 380V 上的 7.5 kW、260 kg、1700 × 550 × 900 mm。柴油页保留 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、≤ 6 mm 和 30 m / 15 m，并改了动力、质量和机架。现场有 380V 时应用电动那一页。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。目录里已经写着：两台都印了 360 kg。德式机是 380V、7.5/9 kW、3–5 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 5 mm。重量相同不是同一台机器。已印出的标题：5 m³/h 的柴油喷涂机是另一档

question.en: Is the hose 32/38 mm, once the outline says “Example - Torque exerted by a Wrench”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“例子扭矩”时，软管是 32/38 mm 吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Yes, the same hose cell as electric Type 511.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：是，和电动 511 的软管格相同。

question.en: Under “Moment Converter”, can it replace a Diesel 30 trailer pump?
question.zh: 在“弯矩”这一节里，它能代替柴油30拖泵吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. Diesel 30 is a 15 m³/h concrete pipeline pump.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不能。柴油30是 15 m³/h 的混凝土管道泵。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Law of Lever” — Is 360 kg shared with the German type?
question.zh: “定律”旁边仍要印着的是什么：360 kg 和德式机一样吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Both print 360 kg. The German type is 380 V, 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa and ≤ 5 mm. The weight match is not the same machine.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。两台都印了 360 kg。德式机是 380V、7.5/9 kW、3–5 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 5 mm。重量相同不是同一台机器。
